questions.question: Review the adaptation of the Russian “empty space” pun as “There is nobody in that corner!” / “I am not a nobody! I am your dean!” This preserves the shift from apparent absence to personal importance; the Russian author text and image are unchanged.

localizations.source: Review the adaptation of the Russian “empty space” pun as “There is nobody in that corner!” / “I am not a nobody! I am your dean!” This preserves the shift from apparent absence to personal importance; the Russian author text and image are unchanged.
localizations.ru: Проверить адаптацию игры «пустое место»: в EN реплики переданы как “There is nobody in that corner!” / “I am not a nobody! I am your dean!”, чтобы сохранить переход от отсутствия человека к его значимости. Русский авторский текст и изображение сохранены.
